House Bill 892 (COMMITTEE SUBSTITUTE) By: Representatives Holcomb of The Senate Committee on Regulated Industries and Utilities offered the 101st, Buckner of the 137th, Miller of the 62nd, Evans of the 57th, and Barrett of the 24th following substitute to HB 892:
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Article 1 of Chapter 24A of Title 43 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to massage therapy practice generally, so as to prohibit massage therapy businesses from … is further amended by adding a new subsection to Code Section 43-24A-15, relating to unlawful acts, to read as follows: "(g) Beginning on August 1, 2026, it shall be a violation of this chapter for any person or entity to open for business or otherwise operate a perform massage therapy business between 10:00 P.M. 1:00 A.M. and 6:00 A.M."
SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
